title: Chapter 425 Messenger
content:
Chapter 425 Messenger

Dahuai Territory had just experienced a great war. Although the losses were not great, the situation was unclear. It was not suitable to make enemies with other forces, especially those that could barely be called allies.

In the Guancheng, Wang Shuo, Zhao Bangde, and Zhu Dongheng looked at the sand table in front of them, thinking.

The old enemies disappeared, and new enemies would surely emerge. The alliance that had joined forces to fight the enemy before had now become a new threat.

After capturing the Guancheng, Zhao Bangde sent out scouts to find out the news around.

The sand table was left by the previous defenders, with detailed markings of the forces near the Guancheng.

There was also a topographic map of the entire Tiexue Ridge.

Including the Qingyang City forces in the east, the Sunset City forces in the north, and the Wagliang Empire of the demon race in the west.

Soon, the spies came to report.

The territory of the Tiexue Lord had been divided up by three forces.

Strictly speaking, there were four forces, although Dahuai Territory only occupied one city.

Not long after, Sunset City and Qingyang City sent envoys.

"I am Wang Hui (Li Ming), meet the three county governors."

In a hall in Guancheng, Wang Shuo and the other two met the two envoys.

"Congratulations to the three county governors for the successful defense. This is a little gift from our two lords."

One of the envoys, Wang Hui, ordered someone to hand over a gift list.

Wang Shuo took the gift list handed over by the soldier, glanced at it, and handed it to Zhao Bangde.

It said energy crystals and some supplies. Wang Shuo was also a man who had seen the world and was not too surprised.

"Two envoys, you have worked hard all the way! Please take a seat."

After sitting down, Wang Shuo and the others spoke to see what the purpose of their trip was.

In fact, you can guess without thinking, naturally, it is to consolidate the alliance relationship.

After all, at this time, in the area of Tiexueling, the strongest power is the Wagliang Empire.

The territory of the monster is larger than the territory of the entire three families combined.

There may be other reasons why the monsters did not launch a large-scale attack.

Wang Hui bowed and said, "This time, we formed an alliance with the Great Huai Territory and broke through the Iron Blood City in one fell swoop. Our two lords are very pleased."

"But at this time, a new threat has emerged, that is, the Wagliang Empire."

"The Demon King is in seclusion at this time, striving for the strongest king level. At the same time, there is a human empire, the Roland Empire, to the west of the demon territory, threatening the Wagliang Empire, so they dare not launch a large-scale attack on the surrounding forces."

"But the situation at this time has been broken, and the four demon kings under the Demon King have already planned to expand their territory."

Wang Shuo was surprised when he heard the demon king.

"How strong are the demon kings under the Demon King?"

"Wang Junshou, your Great Huai Territory has just been unsealed, and the four demon kings under the Demon King are stationed to the west of the Wagliang Empire, guarding against the Roland Empire. So, in fact, we have never seen it."

"But each of them has the strength of a high-level general."

Wang Shuo was lucky at this time.

Wang Shuo had won several battles with monsters, which made him underestimate the monsters.

But he didn't expect that he hadn't even met a big boss.

It seems that the strength of the monsters is indeed unfathomable.

Wang Shuo didn't know how strong the monster king was.

For high-level warriors, Wang Shuo never dared to say that he could win.

After practicing to this level, Wang Shuo had long understood that even in the same level, there was a huge difference in strength.

To establish a foundation in this chaotic world, both personal strength and military strength are indispensable.
